cells.gaps: Where the record is held is not stated, and no local government other than Juba City Council is named. Every fact is dated October 2022: nothing falls inside the governance window or the last twelve months, and whether the system outlasted its start is not established.
cells.note: One city council announced a payer register as just started in October 2022, which is a system being piloted in one place. Stage 3 needs a system past its pilot and live in local governments beyond that city, held in a stated place.
